Focus: Improving speech enhancement by more effectively leveraging spatial information in multi-channel audio.
Method: Based on Wave-U-Net, it introduces a cross-channel attention mechanism to weigh information from different channels, leading to better use of spatial cues.
Results (STOI): Improves STOI from 0.926 (unprocessed) to 0.951 in a representative speech enhancement task.

Focus: Achieving real-time (low-latency) target speaker extraction on a single-channel device for live applications.
Method: Uses a causal Conformer architecture conditioned on a target speaker's embedding to extract their speech from a mixed stream in real-time.
Results (STOI): In a two-speaker mixture, improves STOI from 0.68 (unprocessed) to 0.83 with minimal algorithmic delay.

Focus: Enhancing speech intelligibility for hearing-impaired listeners in complex, reverberant, multi-talker scenarios for hearing aid applications.
Method: Processes two-channel audio using a TCN-Conformer network guided by a speaker embedding. The output is then compensated for the listener's hearing loss profile.
Results (STOI): Significantly improves intelligibility. Systems in similar hearing aid challenges show STOI improvements from ~0.55 (unprocessed) to ~0.80 after processing.
